title: I captured images of my first-ever solar eclipse with the Unistellar Equinox 2 — now 20% off for Black Friday
summary: Equipped with an eQuinox 2 and a solar filter, I managed to capture the moment of a lifetime. This versatile instrument is now on sale for Black Friday, along with the rest of the Unistellar smart telescope range.
contentText:

The start of the 2026 partial solar eclipse. Future Using the eQuinox 2 with a solar filter, I was able to capture all of the stages of the 2026 partial solar eclipse. Future Maximum coverage of the solar disk during the 2026 partial solar eclipse in my area. Future On Aug. 12, 2026, the UK witnessed its best solar eclipse since 1999, wowing the entire country with coverage ranging between 88-96%. I feel so blessed to have witnessed it and honestly, I owe that opportunity to the Unistellar eQuinox 2. After hiking up Kelston Roundhill in Somerset and setting up, I was able to safely watch the eclipse on my iPad through all of its stages and capture images at every moment.

I got to capture the moment of a lifetime, thanks to the Unistellar eQuinox 2. Future Thanks to smart device integration, I was able to quickly snap pictures of the solar eclipse whilst observing with solar eclipse glasses. Future After attaching the solar filter to the Equinox 2, I simply clicked "Go-to" on the sun from the Unistellar app and waited for it to find the blinding solar disk, which showed up on my screen as an orange disk. There was no issue with the eQuinox 2 finding the sun, so I could focus on capturing images or watching it with solar eclipse glasses.

It not only gave me the opportunity to photograph the event, but it gave me a closer view than I had with my solar eclipse glasses. For something that is unlikely to happen again in my lifetime, I am amazed to get such a front-row seat.

Before pointing any Unistellar telescope at the sun, you must have an official solar filter attached to avoid damaging the sensor. Future The Unistellar eQuinox 2 automatically tracks the sun throughout the sky during observation, so you can focus on photography. Future Unistellar sells solar filters for its entire smart telescope range, including for other models like the eVscope 2 and the beginner-friendly Odyssey model . For Black Friday 2026 , they are offering 20% off all of their smart telescopes, solar filters and backpacks. If telescopes aren't your bag, they are also including a free accessory pack with every purchase of their Envision smart binoculars, worth $357.

These smart telescopes aren't just for solar viewing, with their nighttime performance delivering high-quality photos of star clusters , nebulas and galaxies . They make locating night sky targets easy and make astrophotography possible even from areas saturated with light pollution.
